incidental_context.topic: Repair undertaking, signed letter and precise rent amounts
incidental_context.treatment: Context retained without independent numerical or document-form requirements.

incidental_context.alternative: An answer may mention the original and revised amounts to explain the dispute, but their precise figures are unnecessary once the direction of the revision and notice condition are accurately conveyed.

incidental_context.treatment: Statutory context; no independent required application item.

reference_uncertainties.uncertainty: Section 3(3) contains a purpose-limited deeming rule. The trial court treated the Board as a local authority within section 4, while the High Court said that characterization was difficult. The permitted extracts do not justify treating the High Court as having categorically decided the opposite status question or supplying a target-court determination.

Original entry was unauthorized, but a later Bombay Government rent arrangement is reported. The excerpts do not independently settle whether the resulting relationship was a lease, statutory tenancy, licence or another arrangement for all relevant purposes.

The rent arrangement is attributed to the Government of Bombay. Whether any legally relevant tenancy or similar relationship was later created by the statutory Board is unestablished. This uncertainty does not erase the separately supported property-vesting basis relevant to section 3-A(a).

reference_uncertainties.uncertainty: The statutory text includes provisions concerning Government grants, Government-leased or requisitioned premises, and premises taken on lease. The extracts do not establish the necessary lease, requisition or grant predicates for applying those provisions to these rooms.

The petitioner supplies the societies' asserted common housing purpose and different Rent Act treatment. The excerpts do not independently establish sufficiently detailed ownership, financing, statutory obligations, powers or operational characteristics of those societies to determine material equivalence.

Although the High Court's conclusion is reported, the supplied material does not reproduce a developed respondent-side justification or complete constitutional reasoning about the Board and cooperative societies. The absence concerns the available extracts, not necessarily the historical proceedings.
The question withholds the target court's reasoning and disposition. No criterion requires a prediction of constitutional validity, invalidity, relief or final dismissal.

reference_uncertainties.issue: Legal scope of additional supplied statutes
reference_uncertainties.uncertainty: The unrelated LAW provisions may contain detailed substantive rules, but their inclusion does not establish a live factual issue or applicability to this historical Bombay housing proceeding. In particular, a conditional willingness to waive a notice is not automatically a statutory waiver of forfeiture.

The judgment-report text contains OCR irregularities, citation-link markup and page-number insertions. Witnesses use short contiguous substrings of the supplied originals, preserving those irregularities where they occur. A mechanical mismatch in the provisional reference's quotations is not treated as evidence that the underlying criterion is false.

reference_limitations: This is a source-only model proposal for annotation-item design, not audited human gold, legal certification, or a reconstruction of the withheld target judgment.
All 38 proposed items have equal weight and use binary satisfaction criteria. Their separate expected_state fields describe the source-grounded nature of the required relation, not a grading outcome.
Each item is independently assessable. Necessary actor, property, statutory scope, historical stage, polarity or qualifying condition remains attached to the relation being assessed.
A response need not reproduce the criterion's exact words or incidental amounts, dates and suit identifiers when the necessary material relation is accurately conveyed.
Reported litigant assertions and lower-court determinations must remain attributed. Recounting a historical finding does not establish its endorsement by the withheld target court.
The Board's conditional offer to waive its notice is a historical fact. It does not itself trigger or establish application of a separate statutory forfeiture-waiver provision.

The category OPEN_CONSTITUTIONAL_ASSESSMENT permits a conditional, source-supported evaluation. It does not allow replacing known statutory wording, property vesting, reported court findings or comparator assertions with generic uncertainty.
OPEN_EVIDENTIARY_LIMIT and OPEN_RECORD_LIMIT require identifying the particular unsupported comparison or missing justification, rather than merely stating that the result is unknown.

Statutory provisions supplied in the LAW packet are not presumed applicable merely because they appear alongside the case. Only the Article 14 guarantee has a directly established connection to the target-stage constitutional issue.

The original judgment excerpts are public reports rather than original agreements, notices, pleadings, exhibits or complete lower-court opinions. Missing facts are preserved as uncertainties rather than supplied by inference.
The repair of provisional quotation witnesses concerns exact source-text correspondence. It does not automatically validate or invalidate the associated substantive criterion.

No evaluated legal report, system method, preferred outcome or performance score has been used. The proposed replacement items reflect the specified annotation manual and the permitted source record alone.
